title: Latent Lattice Language Models
title_zh: 潜变量晶格语言模型
abstract: Language models typically increase per-token computation through deeper or looped layers and latent reasoning steps, while richer residual connections improve information flow across layers. We instead increase computational capacity: the number of active computational states a model maintains. We introduce the Lattice of Latents, a set of per-layer horizontal latent streams that run recurrently along time, alongside the vertical residual stream that flows through depth. Like hyper-connections, mHC, and attention or value residuals, the Lattice enhances the residual stream, but rather than adding or rerouting residual pathways through depth, it provides companion computational states that persist across tokens. Unlike hybrid Transformer-SSM architectures, whose recurrent states primarily serve as internal memory for sequence mixing, these latents directly condition the vertical stream's attention, KV-cache writes, MLP computation, and decoding. On Transformers trained on 20B FineWeb-Edu tokens, a 406M-parameter Lattice model lowers validation perplexity from 15.41 to 14.40 over a parameter-matched Transformer. These gains extend across architectural variants. The Lattice composes with prior residual-stream enhancements: with hyper-connections and input residuals, it lowers validation perplexity from 15.41 (base Transformer) and 14.22 (Transformer with the same enhancements) to 13.61. On Gated DeltaNet, Mamba-2, Triadic GDN, and GDN-Mamba-2 hybrids, it improves perplexity at every tested native state size, with Lattice-GDN and Lattice-Triadic-GDN variants outperforming pure baselines with 4x larger native states. These results identify persistent per-layer state as a complementary axis for scaling language-model computation.
summary_zh: 传统语言模型通过加深网络增加计算，本文提出增加模型维持的活跃计算状态数量来提升计算容量。
引入潜变量晶格，在各层增加沿时间循环的水平潜流，作为跨token持久化的伴随计算状态，直接参与注意力及MLP等计算。
实验表明该结构显著降低验证困惑度，且能与现有残差增强方法叠加，其效果可媲美4倍原生状态的基线模型。

title: ScaleVLA: Scaling Vision-Language-Action Models to 552 Billion Parameters
title_zh: ScaleVLA：将视觉-语言-动作模型扩展至5520亿参数
abstract: Frontier Vision-Language Models (VLMs) such as GPT-6 Astra have demonstrated remarkable capabilities in robot control, suggesting that broad pretraining provides knowledge valuable for physical action. Yet most Vision-Language-Action (VLA) policies still rely on much smaller VLM backbones, leaving this potential largely untapped. We ask whether frontier-scale representations can provide a stronger foundation for robot learning. We introduce ScaleVLA, which connects a 552B DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash backbone to a trainable action DiT, and systematically compare VLMs from 2B to 552B under a shared training setup. We evaluate three fundamental capabilities of robot foundation models. In sample efficiency, just 10 demonstrations outperform a 2B backbone trained with 50 (87.8% vs. 85.6%). In generalization, LIBERO-PRO success reaches 45.1%, compared with at most 31.3% for smaller backbones. In precise manipulation, real-world charger insertion improves from 4/10 to 9/10 successes, with gains concentrated in contact-sensitive alignment. Despite its scale, ScaleVLA achieves 216 ms median latency per action chunk. Our findings suggest that frontier VLMs can serve not only as reasoning agents, but also as powerful representational foundations for efficient and generalizable robot policies.
summary_zh: 现有VLA策略多采用小规模VLM骨干，未充分利用前沿大模型在机器人控制中的潜力。
提出ScaleVLA，将552B的DeepSeek骨干与可训练动作DiT相连，在统一设定下对比2B至552B的VLM。
552B模型在样本效率、泛化与精细操作上均显著提升，且动作延迟仅216ms，证明前沿VLM可作为高效泛化机器人策略的表征基础。

title: ViRA: Toward Ultra-High-Resolution Visual Agents via Cross-Input Relative Policy Optimization
title_zh: ViRA：基于跨输入相对策略优化的超高分辨率视觉智能体
abstract: Visual agents answer questions about ultra-high-resolution photos by zooming into the relevant regions. However, existing agents often answer from common sense instead of reading the evidence. Reinforcement learning (RL) on the final answer cannot correct this, because a guess earns the same reward as reading. We propose Cross-Input Relative Policy Optimization (CrossRPO), which trains agents on contrast sets. A contrast set asks one question about several versions of an image that differ only in a small region with the evidence and have different answers, so only reading the evidence solves the whole set. CrossRPO rewards solving the whole set, and we prove that it does not reinforce a set answered from common sense. We build contrast sets for training (ViRA-Train) and evaluation (ViRA-Bench) by editing one small object in images of 21 to 120 megapixels, and we photograph further sets with real changes (ViRA-Bench-Real) to exclude editing traces. We train two Visual Reasoning Agents, ViRA-9B and ViRA-27B, with CrossRPO on only about 3,500 items of ViRA-Train each. CrossRPO achieves 63.3% set accuracy on ViRA-Bench at the maximum resolution, against 59.3% for GRPO. ViRA-9B is the most accurate open model of its size on all benchmarks, and ViRA-27B outperforms Claude Haiku 5.5 and GPT-6-Luna, both at their highest thinking level, on most benchmarks.
summary_zh: 超高分辨率视觉智能体常凭常识猜测而非阅读证据作答，传统RL无法区分猜测与阅读的奖励。
提出跨输入相对策略优化（CrossRPO），在对比集上训练，仅当阅读图像局部差异证据才能解出全集并获奖励。
构建ViRA-Train与ViRA-Bench数据集，训练的ViRA模型在多数基准上超越同尺寸开源模型及部分闭源大模型。

title: When Tool Names Are Not Identities: Measuring Provider Misbinding in MCP-Based AI Agents
title_zh: MCP智能体中的工具-提供者误绑定测量
abstract: Large language model (LLM) applications increasingly act as agents that select and invoke external tools. The Model Context Protocol (MCP) standardizes this interaction by allowing clients to compose tools advertised by multiple servers. However, tool metadata used for discovery and selection is not, by itself, necessarily bound to a verified provider identity. This paper studies this gap as tool-provider misbinding: a failure in which a request intended for a legitimate provider is instead resolved to an attacker-controlled tool. The attacker does not compromise the host, LLM, legitimate server, or network channel; it only operates another MCP server that advertises tools with chosen metadata. We formulate tool provider misbinding as an attacker-controlled tool-selection optimization problem and evaluate it in a controlled MCP environment across five LLM-based clients. The results show that interactions drive misbinding. The strongest failures occur when exact-name collision, task-aligned description, and compatible schema reinforce one another, but authority-enhanced descriptions with compatible schema can also cause wrong-provider execution or unresolved provider ambiguity without name collision. Different models expose the same provider-binding weakness differently, including attacker-controlled provider selection, clarification requests, and unstable or inconsistent provider resolution.
summary_zh: MCP协议中工具元数据未绑定验证身份，导致请求被解析至攻击者工具，即工具-提供者误绑定。
将误绑定建模为攻击者控制的工具选择优化问题，并在受控MCP环境中跨五个LLM客户端评估。
发现名称冲突、任务对齐描述与兼容模式叠加会引发最强误绑定；不同模型均暴露提供者绑定弱点。

title: Trustworthy Numerical Software in the Age of AI: What Would Turing Do?
title_zh: AI时代的可信数值软件：图灵会怎么做？
abstract: AI coding agents can now produce numerical software faster than human experts can review it, raising serious concerns about usability and reliability. These and other AI tools are already transforming mathematics and software, and they will soon transform mathematical software. These concerns motivated us to assess AI-generated numerical linear algebra (NLA) kernels, which we did through an audit of a recent public GPU QR competition. All five leading kernels passed the competition's accuracy tests, and the winning kernel achieved a 107-fold speedup over the competition's baseline, which calls NVIDIA's QR routine. Yet each failed at least once on new inputs, even those from the competition's generator, under the same checker, while the baseline passed them all. In light of this, we want to develop reusable formalizations of numerical analysis methods, which remain sparsely represented in existing formal libraries. We describe VSCL, our Lean library of mathematical foundations for numerical computing. We also propose VERNA to connect these tasks by using formalized results to guide kernel assessment against explicit specifications. Drawing on Turing's work on rounding-error analysis and program checking, we discuss design principles for developing trustworthy numerical software when direct human checking is impractical.
summary_zh: AI生成的数值软件速度远超人工审查，引发可靠性担忧，需评估其生成的NLA内核。
审计GPU QR竞赛发现，虽领先内核通过测试且提速107倍，但在新输入下均失败。
提出Lean库VSCL与框架VERNA，利用形式化结果指导内核评估，设计可信软件原则。

title: Right Reason, Wrong Advice: Evaluating Recourse in LLM Explanations of Denied Requests
title_zh: 正确原因，错误建议：评估LLM拒绝请求解释的追索有效性
abstract: Language models increasingly write the explanations people receive when a rule system denies their request. If several rules deny the request independently, an explanation can name a true reason and still leave the person denied after they fix it. We call the missing property recourse validity: changing what the explanation cites, without changing what was asked for, can flip the decision. We compute it exactly, and a hitting-set argument predicts from the policy alone when a correct reason fails. In six of seven rule systems ported from access control and US benefit eligibility, a single correct reason almost never gives recourse when several reasons apply. Across 20 LLMs, checks of whether the cited reasons are correct, computed or asked of an LLM judge, are close to chance at spotting this failure, as the argument predicts. A strong judge asked whether acting on the explanation would work does spot it. Stronger and reasoning models do better but still fail on many denials with four or more independent reasons. Asking for every rule helps every open model with room to improve. Explanations of eligibility decisions should be built from the decision function and judged by whether acting on them works.
summary_zh: LLM解释拒绝请求时，仅给出真实原因可能无法让用户修改后获批，此缺陷称为缺乏追索有效性。
基于命中集方法计算追索有效性发现，多规则拒绝时单一原因几乎无效，且现有正确性检查无法识别该失败。
强评判者或要求列出所有规则可改善此问题，建议从决策函数构建解释并按行动有效性评判。

title: SciResearch-Eval: Evaluating Scientific Judgment in Autonomous Experimental Agents
title_zh: SciResearch-Eval：评估自主实验Agent的科学判断力
abstract: We introduce SciResearch-Eval, an interactive benchmark of scientific judgment built on a standard laboratory problem: measuring a material's thermal properties by heating it and fitting a heat-conduction simulator. An agent designs its own experiments, uses a supplied simulator that may be under-resolved or physically wrong, and reports each property with a 95% interval. To our knowledge it is the first benchmark to combine agent-designed experiments, a deliberately flawed simulator, and proper scoring of calibrated intervals against exact ground truth. On a held-out split (93 tasks, 9 models, 2,511 episodes), models handle procedural traps. When the simulator is missing physics, most report wrong values while stating they are 95% sure: their ranges contain the truth in 20-62% of cases, against 94% for GPT-6 Astra and 99% for Claude Fable 5.2. At default effort the failing Claude 5.5 models rarely diagnose the missing physics (Opus in 35% of episodes, against 66% for Astra), and even when they do, their ranges often miss; Astra and Fable design experiments in which the flawed simulator is accurate, such as gentle heating, which keeps Astra calibrated even when it does not name the cause. Asking for wider intervals does not help; stating the strategy improves interval scores 1.6-2.5-fold, replicated on a pre-registered fresh split, but coverage barely moves. A pre-registered effort ablation shows that the correction is latent in the Claude 5.5 models: at maximum effort Opus improves more than tenfold and is no longer detectably behind Astra at default, but only with 13-31 times more reasoning; older and open-weight models gain nothing. Fable 5.2 is the most accurate model at default effort (interval score 1.9 times better than Astra's) but writes 6 times as many tokens, and at Astra's token count it falls short. We release the environment, graders and harness.
summary_zh: 现有基准缺乏对Agent设计实验、处理有缺陷模拟器及校准不确定性的综合评估，故提出SciResearch-Eval。
该基准结合Agent自主设计实验、使用可能缺失物理机制的模拟器，并利用精确真值对95%置信区间进行严格评分。
实验发现模型易被缺陷模拟器误导导致校准失败；明确提示策略可改善区间评分，提高推理努力度可释放模型潜在纠错能力。

title: Optimistic Verifiers Get Hacked: Reward Hacking Under an Exact Process Oracle
title_zh: 乐观验证器易受攻击：精确过程预言机下的奖励黑客
abstract: Reinforcement learning from verifiable rewards inherits whatever its verifier gets wrong. Outside mathematics and code the verifier is a proxy, a rubric, a learned judge or a hand-written checker, and its distance from the true objective is never measured, so a rising reward cannot be told apart from a hack. We build a setting where the true reward is exactly computable at the process level: executable authorization policies over 124,416 contexts admit an oracle that lists every minimal sufficient reason for every decision. We compile these policies into exact process rewards, degrade the verifier along seven realistic axes (outcome-only, sufficiency, recall-only, extraction noise, coarse taxonomy, stale policy, LLM judge), and train against each while the exact verifier scores every rollout. Four phenotypes appear. Optimistic verifiers are hacked by padding: the sufficiency proxy ends at 0.940 while true faithfulness falls from 0.731 to 0.667 on 96 held-out episodes. Outcome-only verifiers saturate and stop teaching, noise dilutes, and ranking-preserving gaps do no harm. A model-free audit of the verifier, its selection error and gap sign, together with a short saturation pilot, anticipates which phenotype a run will produce. Across nine configurations spanning two frameworks, two model vendors, two adapter sizes, three precisions, two initialisations and two seeds, the phenotypes recur, sufficiency damage is positive in all 10 replication cells and beyond two standard errors in 7, and optimistic gaps remain the steeper branch. The damage magnitude does not replicate, and five pre-registered attempts to explain it are reported as they fell. We release the testbed, the training instrumentation, and 14 real public policies (Cedar, OPA, Gatekeeper) ported to executable oracles.
summary_zh: 可验证奖励的RL会继承验证器的错误，代理验证器与真实目标的偏差导致奖励上升无法与黑客行为区分。
构建可精确计算真实奖励的授权策略测试床，沿7个现实轴降级验证器并训练，发现4种奖励黑客表型。
提出无模型审计与短饱和预试验来预测表型，在多种配置下复现表型，乐观验证器受填充攻击导致忠实度下降。
comment: 30 pages. A shorter version, "The Verifier Gap", appears at the NeurIPS 2026 Workshop on Meta-Agents (non-archival)

title: Evaluating Cultural Reasoning and Robustness in LLMs for Spanish Political Discourse
title_zh: LLM在西班牙政治话语中的文化推理与鲁棒性评估
abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used to interpret, generate, and mediate public-facing language, which makes their reliability especially consequential in politically sensitive settings. Although sentiment analysis is a common task in this area, affective meaning in social media discourse is often conveyed through culturally situated and pragmatically indirect cues that are not well captured by label-centric evaluation alone. In this paper, we evaluate the robustness of LLMs for sentiment analysis of Spanish political discourse from social media, with emphasis on culturally situated affective interpretation. We introduce a diagnostic protocol that combines three independent human annotation views into Gold and Ambiguous subsets, and extends the corpus with a Synthetic subset built from sentiment-flipped counterfactuals selected through model-conditioned perplexity and LLM-as-a-judge criteria. Using this framework, we compare proprietary and open-weight models under zero-shot and few-shot prompting, focusing on predictive robustness across human agreement conditions and counterfactual shift. Our results show that annotation ambiguity and counterfactual perturbation reveal failure modes that conventional evaluation on the original corpus tends to obscure. GPT-4.1-mini remains the most stable among the evaluated models, whereas the two smaller open-weight models degrade more markedly under synthetic perturbations, and few-shot prompting provides only limited gains. Overall, the paper contributes a reproducible protocol for robustness-oriented evaluation in political sentiment analysis, an empirical characterization of model behavior under ambiguity and sentiment-flipped counterfactuals, and a publicly available Spanish social media dataset with three-way human sentiment annotations.
summary_zh: 现有LLM情感分析多依赖标签，难以捕捉政治话语中文化情境与语用间接线索，需评估其鲁棒性。
提出结合三方人工标注与情感反转反事实扩充的诊断协议，在零样本与少样本下对比评估各模型。
发现标注歧义与反事实扰动能暴露常规评估掩盖的失效模式；GPT-4.1-mini最稳定，小模型退化显著。
贡献了面向鲁棒性的可复现评估协议、模型行为实证及公开的西班牙社交媒体数据集。
comment: Accepted for publication in Latin American Conference on Informatics (CLEI 2026)

title: Procedure without Judgment: What Small Language Models Learn under an Exact Verifier
title_zh: 无误差验证器下小语言模型的学习机制
abstract: When an authorization policy blocks an agent's tool call, the audit log should name the facts that forced the decision and nothing more. For an executable policy over an enumerable context space this minimal sufficient reason can be computed exactly, so an explanation is scored against ground truth rather than a proxy for it. We use that exactness to ask what a model can learn from a verifier that has no error in it. The explainer sees one request and one decision, never the policy, and has thirty turns in which it may call the policy on altered requests and ask whether a candidate set of facts is sufficient. Frontier models find the exact reason about half the time with the tools alone, and one sentence telling them to shrink the answer lifts Haiku 4.5 from 58% to 75%. A 4B model fine-tuned on 2000 traces of the deletion algorithm reaches 92% on the policy it was trained on. Teacher kind is what moves this: at matched data size the algorithm-taught student leads the frontier-taught one in all three training seeds, and the two arms never overlap. What the student learns is a fixed schedule of sufficiency checks, and the schedule does not travel. On three public policies it never saw, its answers stay sufficient (94%) and stop being minimal (48%), while Haiku under the same sentence is exact on all 47 episodes. Reinforcement learning from the exact reward leaves held-out accuracy where it was and inverts the strategy, from probing the policy to spending the entire budget on sufficiency checks. The oracle made the effect of training legible, but it did not make training better.
summary_zh: 问题：探究模型从无误差精确验证器中能学到什么；方法：让模型通过交互工具探测策略并生成最小充分事实集；结论：前沿模型仅靠工具约半数找到精确原因，提示缩减答案可提升表现。
问题：小模型能否泛化精确推理能力；方法：用删除算法轨迹微调4B模型并与前沿模型教学对比；结论：算法教学优于前沿教学，但学到的固定检查调度无法迁移至未见策略。
问题：精确奖励能否改善强化学习训练；方法：使用精确奖励信号进行强化学习；结论：未见策略准确率未提升且策略反转，精确验证器使训练效果可解释但未使其更优。

title: Safe Resemblance, Silent Propagation: Limits of Text-Similarity Guardrails for AI Agent Safety
title_zh: 文本相似性安全护栏在AI代理中的局限性
abstract: When AI agents relay information to one another, an output can preserve an injected instruction's effect on downstream agents even after its wording changes, yet legitimate quotation and template reuse can produce high textual overlap with the source, so text-similarity guardrails that attempt to flag the former risk conflating these two cases. We test this distinction using DonkeyRail, a public classifier combining BLEU, ROUGE-L, and METEOR features, deployed in a controlled three-agent email relay, defining a behavioral measure in which an output counts as functional (the injected procedure induces fresh computations in two subsequent agents) independent of the detector's score, alongside legitimate controls that explicitly authorize quotation and reuse. At its default threshold the classifier misses 8 of 19 functional outputs while flagging 70 of 192 legitimate replies, with every completed quotation and template-reuse reply triggering a false alert; calibrating for low false positives on one template set does not transfer, as the recalibrated threshold detects only one functional output and still produces 15 false alerts on new templates. We also identify an operating-point error in all 21 published classifier configurations, where ROC interpolation replaces direct threshold application, and show formally that high AUC against a surface-level text criterion provides no distribution-free guarantee of high AUC against the behavioral target, while the existing evaluation labels lack the joint observations needed to estimate the gap. An authorization analysis further shows that identical visible transcripts can require different safety decisions depending on the governing policy, a distinction no observation-only classifier can resolve. These results argue for behavioral and policy-grounded evaluation over text-similarity guardrails.
summary_zh: AI代理间信息传递时，指令效果可隐式传播，而合法引用也会产生高文本重叠，导致相似性护栏混淆二者。
在多代理邮件中继测试中，默认阈值下的分类器漏报近半数功能输出，且将所有合法引用误报，跨模板校准也无法消除误报。
高AUC不保证行为层面的安全，且相同文本记录依策略需不同安全决策，仅靠观测的分类器无法解决此问题。

title: Beyond Leaderboard Ranks: Selecting Software Engineering Agents Under Budget Constraints
title_zh: 预算约束下的软件工程Agent选择
abstract: Teams that adopt LLM agents for issue resolution must decide which agent to pay for, and how much to spend finding out. Leaderboard ranks give weak evidence for this decision. Accuracy differences may be statistically unresolved, reported costs may be inconsistent, and evaluating candidate agents can itself be expensive. We investigate budget-constrained agent selection using 58,197 run--task records extracted from the Holistic Agent Leaderboard (HAL), focusing on SWE-bench and six additional benchmarks. Across seven benchmarks, 27 of 35 steps along the accuracy--cost Pareto frontiers are statistically unresolved. On SWE-bench, a run costing $34.16 trails the $170.78 leader by 14.6 percentage points, but the available tasks cannot statistically distinguish their accuracy. Reported costs also differ from standardized token-based estimates by up to 11.7x, while selective task evaluation can bias estimates of full-benchmark execution cost. We therefore compare evaluation strategies under explicit evaluation budgets and deployment-cost caps. Under advance knowledge of task costs, successive halving reaches our uncertainty-aware selection target on SWE-bench using 6.6% of exhaustive evaluation spend, achieving the lowest cost on six of seven benchmarks and tying on the seventh. Its advantage narrows when task costs are unknown before execution or exact-best selection is required. Our findings motivate decision-oriented agent evaluation that accounts for accuracy uncertainty, validates execution costs, and compares complex selection methods against simple adaptive allocation.
summary_zh: 现有LLM Agent排行榜的排名无法可靠指导选择，其精度差异常无统计显著性，且报告成本不一致。
基于HAL排行榜数据，发现在精度-成本帕累托前沿上大量步长无统计差异，报告成本与标准估算最高偏差11.7倍。
在明确评估预算与部署成本上限下，连续减半策略仅需6.6%的穷举开销即可达成目标，优于其他评估策略。

title: A Scalable Decentralized Event-Triggered Topology-Switching Protocol for Verifiable Safety in Multi-Agent Systems
title_zh: 多智能体系统可验证安全的可扩展去中心化事件触发拓扑切换协议
abstract: This paper develops a decentralized event-triggered topology-switching protocol that allows agents to disconnect from the communication network while preserving state safety and excluding Zeno behavior. We establish a robust barrier function condition that guarantees safety as long as the estimation error remains within a prescribed threshold. Each agent uses locally computable certificates to determine when to connect and disconnect from the network. The certificate construction improves scalability by reducing the complexity of topology-dependent computations from $O(2^N)$ to $O(N)$, where $N$ is the number of agents. We formally prove that the protocol ensures the estimation error does not exceed the prescribed threshold and is non-Zeno. An alternating method computes an error-weighting matrix and a quadratic barrier function that guarantee safety under the proposed protocol. Finally, we evaluate the protocol on four interconnected microgrids. Compared with maintaining network connectivity at all times, the protocol reduces the time agents remain connected while keeping phase and frequency within their safe operating region.
summary_zh: 多智能体断网时难以保证状态安全，提出去中心化事件触发拓扑切换协议，确保安全且排除Zeno行为。
智能体依赖局部可计算证书决定网络连接，将拓扑相关计算复杂度从O(2^N)降至O(N)，提升可扩展性。
在四个互联微电网上评估该协议，相比持续联网，减少了智能体联网时间并维持了安全运行区域。

title: Is This Code Mine? Student Ownership When AI Agents Write the Spec and the Code
title_zh: AI代理编写代码时学生的所有权归属问题
abstract: Software engineering courses are starting to ask students to build entire systems with AI coding agents, but little is known about what students actually do with them and whether they still own what they deliver. If the agent writes both the code and the decisions behind it, the artifacts we grade no longer show what students learned. We studied an assignment in which 18 pairs of students built applications with agents under Spec-Driven Development, combining the mined history of their repositories, the prompts they recorded, and a survey of 33 students. The agents wrote 69\% of the specifications meant to keep students in control, sometimes from a prompt of a few words. Students locate their ownership in the ideas, crediting themselves with half of them but a fifth of the code, yet most could not explain that code to a colleague or modify it without the agent, and what they report having written is unrelated to what their own commits declare. The three teams that met the 100,000-line target did so with generated code the application never uses, in one case proposed by the agent itself, and one team rewrote its history to backdate its specifications. Teaching with agents should therefore assess what students specify, review, and can explain, rather than what they ship, and enforce the engineering process with tools rather than trusting it to students or agents.
summary_zh: 问题：AI代理编写代码及决策时，学生交付物无法反映其学习成果，所有权归属不清。
方法：研究18对学生使用AI代理的作业，结合仓库历史、提示词记录及33人问卷调查。
结论：学生虽自认拥有半数创意但无法解释或修改代码，甚至生成无用代码凑数，建议评估学生的规范与解释能力而非交付物。

title: Lost in the Hallway: Benchmarking Persistent Spatial Memory Across Revisits
title_zh: 迷失在走廊：跨重访的持久空间记忆基准测试
abstract: Persistent spatial understanding is essential for embodied agents to operate reliably in environments they repeatedly encounter. It requires recognizing revisited places despite viewpoint changes, distinguishing them from similar-looking rooms, and updating memories as environments change. Yet existing evaluations often leave physical place identity across separated visits implicit. We introduce ReSpaceBench, a benchmark comprising 3,244 questions across 590 synthetic and real-home scenes, organized into 9 tasks spanning room association, persistent state tracking, and downstream reasoning. Controlled walkthroughs define visits by physical room entry and deliberately include same-type room distractors and cross-session object changes. Our evaluation of 32 models and 3 agentic video-understanding frameworks reveals substantial limitations: the strongest evaluated zero-shot model achieves 50.5% overall accuracy and 52.2% on a 450-question subset, compared with 90.1% for human annotators. The evaluated agentic frameworks offer no overall improvement over direct inference with the same base model. Analysis of agent execution traces reveals evidence omissions and incorrect cross-visit room associations as major failure modes, suggesting that iterative evidence seeking alone does not ensure consistent spatial memory. Further analyses expose a gap between recognizing familiar rooms and identifying the correct visited room, while annotation-guided sampling highlights the importance of preserving intervening visits and transitions. We also provide RS-30K, a separate training dataset from synthetic sources with no template, scene, route, or video overlap with the benchmark. Fine-tuning Qwen3-VL-8B raises overall accuracy from 35.5% to 60.4%, with the largest gains in association and improvements extending to real-life scenes.
summary_zh: 具身智能体需持久空间记忆以应对重访环境，但现有评估未显式考察跨访问的物理位置一致性。
提出 ReSpaceBench 基准，含3244个问题与9项任务，通过受控漫游测试房间关联、状态追踪与推理。
评估发现最强零样本模型准确率仅50.5%，agent框架未改善表现；微调Qwen3-VL-8B可将准确率提至60.4%。

title: Jetriever: Shifting Agent Memory Retrieval from Similarity to Utility
title_zh: Jetriever：将智能体记忆检索从相似度转向效用
abstract: A useful memory need not resemble the question it helps answer. Jetriever ranks each stored memory by Jev's decision score for its usefulness to the current question, replacing similarity search with full-pool utility scoring. On InMind's 125 indirect-query tasks, it places the gold exchange first in 84.8% of cases; matched BM25 and MiniLM controls reach 1.6% and 0.0% when indexing user turns. A 20-question comparison separates finding evidence from ranking it: Jev and Qwen3.5 9B each find 90% of gold exchanges by rank 50, while Laya finds 30%; at rank one, Jev reaches 85% and Qwen3.5 9B 40%. On a dimension-proportional random sample of 60 MemoryAgentBench questions, Jetriever's four-dimension score is 55.4%, against 44.3% for ReFind on the same questions. Jev retrieval costs USD 0.00834 per InMind question and USD 0.03103 per MAB question on average. These results show the value of world knowledge, scores that rank decisive memories first, and affordable full-pool scoring.
summary_zh: 现有智能体记忆检索依赖相似度，但有用记忆未必与问题相似，需转向效用评估。
提出Jetriever，用Jev决策分数对记忆池进行全量效用评分，替代相似度搜索。
实验表明该方法在间接查询任务中首位命中率远超基线，且成本可控，验证了全量效用评分的有效性。
comment: 13 pages, 1 figure, 8 tables. Project repository: https://github.com/imlrz/Jetriever

title: A Taxonomy and Taxonomy-Guided Benchmark Reduction for Spreadsheet Tasks
title_zh: 电子表格任务分类法及基于分类法的基准缩减
abstract: Spreadsheets let millions of end users without programming training do computational work, and teams are increasingly building AI agents to help them. Evaluating each candidate agent configuration across many tasks is costly. Benchmark reduction can lower this cost by selecting a small subset of tasks whose outcomes predict full-benchmark scores, but selecting tasks only for predictive accuracy can leave whole categories of spreadsheet work untested. We contribute a taxonomy of spreadsheet tasks, grounded in a review of benchmarks and refined with the Excel Agent product team at Microsoft, and a benchmark-reduction method that favors taxonomic diversity among similarly predictive choices. On benchmark logs from Microsoft, taxonomy-guided selection broadens coverage at little or no cost in predictive accuracy and often improves prediction on configurations excluded from selection. Broader coverage can therefore support, rather than compromise, predictive accuracy. Generalization remains limited across time: subsets selected using little recent history predict poorly for configurations much later in time. Beyond benchmark reduction, the taxonomy provides a reusable framework for auditing gaps in task coverage, as teams at Microsoft have done.
summary_zh: 评估电子表格AI agent配置成本高，仅追求预测精度的基准缩减会遗漏任务类别。
提出电子表格任务分类法，及在同等预测能力下优先保证分类多样性的基准缩减方法。
实验表明该方法拓宽了覆盖面且不损预测精度，分类法还可用于审计任务覆盖缺口。

title: Learning to Reason with Predictive Gains for Generative Recommendation
title_zh: 基于预测增益推理的生成式推荐
abstract: Reasoning-enhanced generative recommendation (GR) has attracted increasing attention for leveraging the reasoning capabilities of large language models (LLMs) to improve next-item prediction. However, existing methods primarily optimize reasoning through Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) with rule-based rewards determined by final recommendation performance, which faces two key limitations: (i) unmeasured predictive contributions within reasoning, where the predictive contributions of individual reasoning steps are not directly reflected in optimization signals, and (ii) weakly discriminative learning signals within groups, where different reasoning trajectories within the group often receive indistinguishable rewards, limiting effective policy optimization. In this paper, we propose GainReason, a simple yet effective training framework that optimizes reasoning through Predictive Gain (PG). Specifically, PG measures changes in target Semantic ID (SID) log-likelihood induced by individual reasoning sentences, providing contribution-aware and discriminative rewards. We further theoretically establish the alignment between expected PG and the recommendation ranking objective. Building on this signal, we develop PG-based Reasoning Optimization (PGRO) to optimize reasoning generation with sentence-level rewards, supported by a custom causal attention mechanism for efficient PG computation. Additionally, an auxiliary PG-based Reasoning Utilization (PGRU) task adaptively strengthens reasoning-conditioned prediction to complement PGRO. Extensive experiments on three public benchmarks demonstrate that GainReason consistently outperforms competitive baselines and achieves substantial performance gains from reasoning.
summary_zh: 现有GRPO优化推理仅依赖最终推荐结果，存在未度量推理步骤贡献及组内学习信号区分度弱的问题。
提出GainReason框架，利用预测增益(PG)衡量单步推理对目标SID对数似然的变化，提供细粒度奖励。
理论证明PG与推荐排序目标对齐，结合PGRO优化与PGRU辅助任务，实验证实其性能显著优于基线。

title: Just sort it! A note on the LP behind rank-one anti-loop edits
title_zh: 关于秩一反循环编辑中线性规划的排序替代法
abstract: Weight-space programming removes the thinking loops of a small reasoning model by a rank-one edit W' = W + u v^T of an MLP output matrix, where u is a loop direction and v is the solution of a sparse Linear Program (LP) over the neuron activations. We investigate whether the LP is needed. We replace it by a sort: we take the 8 neurons whose activation has the smallest coefficient of variation, and give them equal shares of the push that the LP solution realizes. On Qwen3.5-0.8B the sorted edit scores 67.0% on 1000 problems (MATH-500 and GSM8K) against 67.4% for the LP edit and 9.5% for the unedited model; the paired difference is -0.4 points, with 95% confidence interval [-2.9, +2.1], inside a non-inferiority margin of 5 points declared before the runs. On three further sampling seeds the difference is -0.6 points, interval [-2.0, +0.8], and -0.8 points, interval [-2.3, +0.6], when the dose is set without the LP. The sort does not solve the LP, but the neurons it shares with the LP solution carry most of its mean push. The outcome is that, on this model, the edit acts as a nearly constant bias along u.
summary_zh: 权重空间编程通过求解稀疏线性规划（LP）对MLP输出矩阵进行秩一编辑以消除推理模型的循环，但该LP求解过程较复杂。
本文提出用排序替代LP：选取激活值变异系数最小的8个神经元，均摊LP解的推力，从而简化编辑过程。
在Qwen3.5-0.8B上，排序编辑与LP编辑的准确率差异在预设非劣效边际内，表明排序法非劣于LP法，且编辑近似为沿循环方向的恒定偏置。
comment: 4 pages, 3 tables. Data, code and protocols: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.24286137

title: Rubric-Based AES with LLM Ensembles: Scoring of Student Responses in Critical Online Reasoning Using Ensembles of LLMs
title_zh: 基于评分规则与LLM集成的自动作文评分研究
abstract: Grading student responses is costly and time-consuming. Moreover, human annotators are prone to bias, fatigue, and rater drift, which further limits grading reliability. Various methods have been employed to develop automated essay scoring (AES) systems to reduce these costs and address bias-related issues. These methods range from early text-feature-based systems to current machine-learning and transformer-based models. Specifically, large language models (LLMs) offer the potential to streamline the development of AES systems. However, they are subject to well-known limitations, such as hallucinations and prompt sensitivity. This creates a need to explore the potential of a mixed-methods approach that leverages the synergies among individual LLMs through ensemble formation. We evaluate the potential of ensembles of LLMs to match human-rater agreement when grading student responses in economics and medical education across 103 criteria. We use 631 German-language responses and corresponding human ratings by 2 to 5 annotators from a previously conducted assessment. We experiment with 523 rubric-based prompt configurations across 15 open-weight LLMs and assess their consistency with human raters using Krippendorff's alpha for inter-annotator agreement (IAA) and the Alternative Annotator Test (alt-test). Our results show that replacing one human rater with the best-performing LLM--prompt configuration maintains or improves IAA for 91 of the 103 criteria and that LLMs pass the alt-test for 90 criteria. Our findings suggest that current state-of-the-art LLMs can support AES of German responses in economics and medical education, reducing human workload and enabling faster processing, while validation against human ratings remains necessary.
summary_zh: 人工评分成本高且易受偏差和疲劳影响，现有LLM存在幻觉和提示敏感问题，需探索混合方法提升自动评分可靠性。
构建LLM集成方法，在经济学和医学教育的103个评分标准下，使用523种提示配置评估15个开源LLM与人工评分的一致性。
最佳LLM配置在91个标准上维持或提升评分一致性，90个标准通过替代标注测试，表明LLM可有效辅助德语评分并减轻人工负担。

title: Do Embedding-Map Distances Guide LLM Ideation? Four Tests Against What Came Next
title_zh: 嵌入图距离能否指导LLM构思？四项后续验证测试
abstract: A popular ideation recipe treats an embedding map of existing work as a guide: pick points far from everything and decode them into ideas. I test four ways such distances could guide ideation against what appeared later. (1) Far random directions are not text: no later item reaches a raw cosine above about 0.10 with one (after centring or whitening, 22 of 24 cells stay out of reach), and an LLM decoder shown a target's neighbours, with score-only feedback, writes those neighbours in all six target sets. A neighbour-free search writes coherent text at median cosine 0.57 and 0.47 to interior gaps, beating the nearest existing item on 15 and 14 of 20, but only 0.07 and 0.06 to far points. (2) On k-means cells of a past-only map, the registered hole score mostly tracks cell size and position; three density-based gap scores forecast which cells grow fastest at or below chance (AUC 0.30 to 0.66) and add nothing to momentum in Steam and arXiv, with patents inconclusive; more isolated new Steam games are slightly better reviewed. (3) LLM continuations of arXiv papers stay closer to the source than papers that cite it, under three user prompts and against proposal rewrites (gpt-4o) and April-December 2023 papers (OLMo). Critique lengthens this step beyond content-free revision, replicated on 150 new papers. Revealing a real follow-up's title turns the ideas by 0.032 along a follow-up-specific direction beyond revision; reviewer, oracle and distance feedback add 0.13, 0.08 and 0.34 of that turn (upper bounds 0.46, 0.46, 0.70), and their turn is not separable from revision or their longer step. (4) For inspiration material graded by distance, no inverted U was detected, on an anticipation margin that tracks format more than content. Original tests were registered before running, follow-ups (thirteen requested in two AI-agent reviews) after the main results; all are dated only by local git commits.
summary_zh: 问题：嵌入图中远离现有工作的点能否作为新想法？方法：测试随机远点与后续文本的余弦相似度及LLM解码。结论：远点无法解码为文本，无邻居搜索仅能填补内部空隙而非远点。
问题：基于密度的空隙评分能否预测知识增长？方法：在k-means聚类中评估三种空隙评分对后续增长的预测。结论：空隙评分预测能力不及随机，且未提升动量预测，孤立新游戏评价仅微升。
问题：LLM续写能否产生真正新颖的后续研究？方法：对比LLM续写与真实引用论文对源文的偏离度及不同反馈影响。结论：LLM续写比真实引用更贴近源文，各类反馈带来的方向偏转微弱且与修订步骤不可分。
comment: 48 pages, 5 figures. Code, data pointers and pre-registrations: https://github.com/JaviMaligno/latent-gap-ideas

title: Harness Leverage Across Model Size: A Ladder of Five Local Agent Harnesses from 0.75B to 4.7B
title_zh: 跨模型规模的Harness效应：0.75B至4.7B的五种本地Agent Harness
abstract: A harness turns a model into a system that completes tasks: it builds the prompt, exposes tools and decides when work is done. Harness comparisons hold the model fixed. Model comparisons hold the harness fixed. We vary both: five shipped harnesses, 18 artifact-producing tasks, four locally deployable open-weight models from 0.75B to 4.7B and a 35.5B anchor, with one deterministic checker scoring all 360 ladder cells. The completion-controlling harness, Mingbird, has the highest mean at every size. Of four pre-registered paired contrasts, two survive Holm correction, at 0.75B and 4.7B. Thirteen of sixteen paired intervals exclude zero under the deployment reading, with leads from 0.075 over the strongest rival to 0.819 over the weakest. The completion gate is not the carrier: disabling all six executable checks moves the mean by +0.080, +0.117, +0.003 and -0.004, every interval including zero, and only at 1.9B does disabling it create empty runs. Removing one repeat-blocking rule alone costs 0.411 at 0.75B and leaves eight of eighteen tasks with no artifact. The harness effect is a progress effect: it decides whether a run leaves anything on disk. Of 357 usable cells, 127 leave none of their declared artifacts and 85 of those exit normally, so a scorer that reads exit status credits work that was never written. Whether the effect grows or shrinks with size, four rungs cannot settle: a floor arm produces a rise, a ceiling a decline, and a cross-family rung a peak.
summary_zh: 现有研究固定模型或Harness对比，本文同时变化两者，在18个任务上评估5种Harness与5个模型，构建360个测试单元。
控制任务完成的Mingbird在所有模型规模上均值最高，其优势在0.75B和4.7B上经Holm校正后依然显著。
研究发现Harness效应本质是进度效应，决定运行是否产出文件；且该效应随模型规模的变化趋势无法由现有四档规模定论。

title: Efficient Modeling of Multi-Agent Systems via Structure-Aware Physics-Informed Learning
title_zh: 基于结构感知物理信息学习的多智能体系统高效建模
abstract: Modeling large multi-agent systems poses challenges for trajectory inference and parameter identification, as network size and coupling increase computational demands and partial observations require reconstructing unobserved states. We propose MAS-PINN, a neural-network architecture with a tailored training algorithm for a physics-informed learning framework that leverages the network topology and the agents' similarity to reduce computational and memory costs of simulating and identifying multi-agent systems. Its architecture represents agent trajectories through shared temporal features and agent-specific coefficients. Training alternates between learning features, fitting coupled trajectories, and estimating physical parameters. A matrix-free update exploits local interactions to fit trajectories without forming large global matrices. Experiments on Lorenz rings, Lotka--Volterra networks, and Rössler oscillators show improved trajectory and parameter accuracy over baselines, including inference in large systems and identification under partial observations or unknown topology, alongside substantial computational savings in coefficient fitting.
summary_zh: 大规模多智能体系统轨迹推断与参数识别计算量大，且部分观测需重构未观测状态。
提出MAS-PINN，利用网络拓扑与智能体相似性，通过共享时间特征与特定系数表示轨迹，交替训练并采用无矩阵更新降低计算与内存开销。
实验表明，该方法在部分观测或未知拓扑下提升了轨迹与参数推断精度，并在系数拟合上实现大幅计算节省。

title: VideoNexus: Video Perception Beyond the Reasoning Context
title_zh: VideoNexus：超越推理上下文的视频感知框架
abstract: Understanding long videos requires locating evidence, resolving visual details, and integrating observations into an answer. Even when relevant evidence is present, performing these operations within long, dense visual sequences burdens both perception and reasoning. Video agents enable selective inspection, but returning frames to the planner still accumulates visual information in its reasoning context. Delegating perception reduces this burden, yet sparse sampling can miss decisive details, and per-frame descriptions can preserve context growth. We introduce VideoNexus, a training-free framework that separates detailed video perception from evidence-driven planning and reasoning. The planner controls where to inspect, what to resolve, and how densely to sample. Perception sub-agents process native audio-video in independent contexts and return compact, temporally grounded evidence for iterative search and verification. Using Gemini 3.8 Flash for both planning and perception, VideoNexus achieves 88.6% accuracy on full LVBench, exceeding same-backbone static ingestion and built-in agentic processing by 3.6 and 1.1 points, respectively, at 44% of the latter's measured API cost. A paired LVBench subset ablation shows lower planner input and higher accuracy. With Kimi K3 as the shared backbone, VideoNexus improves over the official Video-GAIA ReAct harness by 8.5 points in our evaluation. These results support compact evidence exchange for combining detailed observation with efficient planning and reasoning.
summary_zh: 长视频理解中，视觉信息累积易加重推理负担，且稀疏采样易漏细节，逐帧描述仍会增长上下文。
提出VideoNexus免训练框架，将视频感知与推理规划分离，由规划器控制检查与采样，感知子代理在独立上下文处理并返回紧凑证据。
在LVBench上准确率达88.6%，超越同骨干方法且API成本降至44%；在Video-GAIA上较ReAct基线提升8.5点，验证了紧凑证据交换的有效性。

title: A Crowd-Audited Atlas of Implicit Bias in LLM-Powered Agents
title_zh: LLM智能体隐式偏差的众包审计图谱
abstract: Prior work has shown that large language models (LLMs) express implicit biases in high-publicity, one-off decision scenarios such as hiring and intelligence assessment. However, as people increasingly employ autonomous, LLM-powered AI agents that make decisions on their behalf in doing day-to-day tasks, it is of critical importance that we understand how implicit biases, based on sociodemographic assumptions, emerge across a broad milieu of workaday decision scenarios. We used the 17 domains of daily activity in the American Time Use Survey (ATUS) to generate an atlas of 506 decision scenarios in which LLMs --- endowed with personas representing different races, gender identities, and political ideologies --- expressed significant implicit bias. Next, in a crowdsourced audit, 500 participants made 8,010 binary choices about which implicitly biased decision scenarios most deserved further review. We found that participants prioritized decision scenarios that had broad relevance (e.g., about food choices), were high stakes (e.g., about health), and where all members of a simulated sociodemographic group made unanimous decisions (because it was a clear indication of stereotyping). They were less swayed by the magnitude of an observed disparity or the specific ATUS domain the decision scenario represented. When examining the rationale behind their prioritization choices, we found that participants often interpreted disparities as traits of demographic groups and judged whether those traits seemed plausible, often based on their own internalized stereotypes. We discuss implications for building personalized AI agents, digital twins, social simulations, and for using crowdsourced bias audits.
summary_zh: 现有研究多关注LLM在单次决策中的隐式偏差，缺乏对日常多场景下自主智能体偏差的系统性理解。
基于ATUS生成506个日常决策场景，赋予不同社会人口属性的LLM人格，发现其存在显著隐式偏差。
众包审计表明，人们优先审查高相关性与高利害且群体决策一致的场景，且常基于内化刻板印象评估偏差。

title: WeVisForensics: Self-Evolving Agent for Omni AI-Generated Video Detection
title_zh: WeVisForensics：面向全维AI生成视频检测的自进化智能体
abstract: Recent advances in video generation call for reliable detection grounded in explicit forensic evidence. However, current methods primarily depend on single-pass chain-of-thought reasoning that overlooks brief or localized artifacts, or on predefined multi-agent workflows that offer limited flexibility in selecting relevant inspections. Even with adaptive investigation, optimizing the investigation policy alone does not directly improve the forensic capabilities of fixed experts. We introduce WeVisForensics, an agentic framework in which a main investigator agent coordinates a self-evolving library of forensic inspector sub-agents spanning visual and audio cues. The investigator learns which artifact type to examine, over which window, and when to conclude, and these interactions provide shared feedback for both levels of agents. Our dual-timescale policy optimization strategy, DTPO, closes this loop through fast reinforcement learning of the investigator and slower refinement of the inspectors, guided by annotated artifact intervals, to report subtle artifacts they once dismissed. Furthermore, we curate ForenCue-30K, combining role-specific forensic annotations and interaction trajectories to supervise individual inspections and their coordination, with an accompanying reinforcement-learning pool. Experiments show that WeVisForensics averages 95.2% detection accuracy across in-domain, out-of-domain and agentic benchmarks, 9.0% above the strongest prior detector, while grounding its verdicts in localized evidence.
summary_zh: 现有AI视频检测依赖单次推理易漏检，或受限于固定多智能体流程缺乏灵活性，且仅优化策略无法提升固定专家的取证能力。
提出WeVisForensics框架，主调查智能体协调自进化的取证子智能体库，并采用双时间尺度策略优化（DTPO）联合优化两级智能体。
构建ForenCue-30K数据集提供监督，实验表明该方法检测平均准确率达95.2%，较最强基线提升9.0%，且基于局部证据给出判定。

title: Premise Recovery in Software Design: What Does This Decision Rest On?
title_zh: 软件设计中的前提恢复：该决策依赖于什么？
abstract: Design decisions shape software architecture, and writing them down preserves the reasons behind it. Architecture decision records (ADRs) capture them, each with its context, choice, and consequences. A decision can depend on earlier ones: reversing one of them would force its review. We call these its premises. Yet ADRs do not always name their premises. When a decision is reversed, engineers supersede its ADR and search by hand for what it affects. That search can miss ADRs resting on an unnamed premise. We frame this as premise recovery: given an ADR with identifiers masked, find its premises among earlier records. We collect 1,060 ADRs from 36 repositories and label 1,529 candidate pairs for 60 target ADRs. Two LLM annotators agree at \k{appa} = 0.859. An independent human annotator, blind to their labels, agrees with the stated/implicit tag on 30 of 32 premises (\k{appa} = 0.875). We compare 7 open-weight models with 2 baselines that use no LLM. Qwen3.8-27B reaches F1 0.756, against 0.466 for word overlap; 2 models added post hoc score similarly. On the 11 premises whose titles barely overlap the target, it finds 0.758, while word overlap finds none. Reasoning raises its recall of implicit premises but not its F1. Word overlap with as many predictions gains 69% as much. We find only 2 to 3 stale dependents, though we searched for unlinked ones in only 30 of 66 supersessions. Open models could thus suggest unwritten premises when a decision is reversed, with precision between 0.68 and 0.78.
summary_zh: 架构决策记录(ADR)常未写明其依赖的早期决策（即前提），导致决策撤销时人工排查易遗漏受影响的ADR。
将此问题定义为前提恢复任务，即掩码目标ADR标识后，从历史记录中找出其前提，并构建了含1060个ADR的数据集。
评估7个开源LLM，Qwen3.8-27B的F1达0.756远超词重叠基线；LLM能有效发现隐式前提，在决策撤销时提供高精度的前提建议。

title: Latent Bridge: Asking for Help Without Words
title_zh: POND：基于隐状态桥接的无解码大模型协作方法
abstract: Text-based model collaboration requires a large model to generate intermediate responses before a smaller model can use its guidance, adding large-model decoding cost to inference. We introduce POND (Prefill-Only, No-Decode), a method that uses a frozen large sender for prefill and a small receiver for all autoregressive decoding. A trainable bridge maps the sender's hidden states to additional attention keys and values, allowing the receiver to use these representations throughout generation. POND also supports periodic review, in which the sender processes the receiver's partial response and updates its guidance through additional prefill passes while preserving the receiver's existing KV cache. Across reasoning and coding benchmarks, POND improves receiver performance with senders from different model families. In particular, GLM-5.3 provides gains comparable to those of Qwen3.8-Max when paired with a Qwen receiver, supporting the effectiveness of representation transfer between independently trained model families. POND further demonstrates its ability to generalize across domains. When trained on math and coding tasks, it transfers directly to general knowledge tasks without additional domain-specific training. These results demonstrate that large frontier model prefill representations can improve small-model generation without requiring large-model autoregressive decoding.
summary_zh: 文本模型协作依赖大模型解码生成中间响应，导致推理成本增加。
提出POND方法，冻结大模型仅做预填充，通过可训练桥接将其隐状态映射为小模型的注意力KV，由小模型完成全部自回归解码。
实验表明POND有效实现跨模型族表征迁移，且在数学与代码上训练后可直接泛化至通用任务，无需大模型解码即可提升小模型性能。

title: Turing Agent: Agentic Formal Verification for Mathematical Research
title_zh: Turing Agent：面向数学研究的智能体形式化验证
abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are rapidly advancing mathematical discovery, moving beyond benchmark-level problem solving to tackle frontier research problems. This progress is ushering mathematics into an era of proof abundance, raising a fundamental challenge: how can we ensure the correctness of the ever-growing volume of AI-generated proofs and transform them into trustworthy, machine-verified mathematical knowledge? We introduce Turing Agent, an agent harness designed to orchestrate end-to-end formal verification of research-level mathematics. Its wo-scale architecture integrates theorem formalization and proof formalization agents, empowered by structured proof decomposition, parallel verification, accumulated proof experience, and selective semantic review. Leveraging our collaborations with theoretical computer science (TCS) researchers, we focus our evaluation on TCS, a particularly demanding domain characterized by intricate quantification, complex dependencies, and stringent semantic requirements. Against direct generation and general-purpose coding harnesses, including Codex CLI and Claude Code, Turing Agent achieves approximately 57-62% faithful formalization success on Formal TCS Bench and 83% overall pass@1 on a TCS-focused subset of RLMEval, using GLM-5.3 and DeepSeek-V4-Pro. Notably, Turing Agent, built on DeepSeek, successfully completes the formal verification of three previously unresolved TCS tasks from OpenAI's October 2026 collection. One particularly challenging TCS problem required about a hundred formally verified auxiliary claims. Moreover, by actively exploring and refining the formalization process, Turing Agent can uncover simpler alternative proofs, expose unnecessary dependencies in original proofs, and generate reusable mathematical knowledge as a byproduct of verification.
summary_zh: AI生成数学证明激增带来正确性挑战，需将其转化为可信的机器验证知识。
提出Turing Agent，采用双尺度架构集成定理与证明形式化智能体，支持并行验证与经验积累。
在理论计算机科学评测中取得83%通过率，并成功验证3个此前未解决的难题，还能发现更简证明。

title: Agent-Native by Design: A Programming Language for Agentic Applications
title_zh: 面向Agent原生设计的编程语言
abstract: Building agentic applications requires combining large language model (LLM) operations, workflow structure and application state, and model-guided routing. With SDKs and agent frameworks, developers connect these components through supporting code that prepares model inputs, propagates state, and dispatches model-selected steps. Workflow changes can require coordinated updates to this code, increasing development and testing effort. Splitting execution logic between application code and framework internals also limits compiler visibility into control flow and state dependencies, hindering automatic optimization. We introduce Agent-Native Programming, which unifies these three components with shared execution semantics. We realize this approach in Jac, a Python-superset language, through "by llm()" for typed model operations and tool use, Object-Spatial Programming for workflow structure and state, and "visit ... by llm()" for model-guided routing. The routing construct derives the model's choices from executable workflow steps and schedules the selected steps. This explicit connection between model decisions and program execution gives the compiler and runtime a common basis for dependency analysis and automatic optimization. Across five benchmarks and five baselines, Jac achieves a 1.8-8.7x reduction in AI-integration code relative to the OpenAI SDK, with competitive observed task quality and lower coding-agent development effort. Two case studies demonstrate speculative execution and service partitioning through configuration alone, using program analysis and runtime checks to preserve workflow behavior under stated conditions.
summary_zh: 现有SDK将LLM操作、工作流与状态分离，导致代码更新繁琐且阻碍自动优化。
提出Agent原生编程范式，在Jac语言中统一三者，提供模型操作、状态管理及路由语法。
Jac相比OpenAI SDK减少1.8-8.7倍集成代码，且支持仅靠配置实现推测执行等优化。

title: Deep Learning for Physicists: From Linear Regression to Reasoning Models
title_zh: 面向物理学家的深度学习：从线性回归到推理模型
abstract: These lecture notes are based on an introductory course on neural networks and deep learning that the author taught in the School of Mathematical Sciences at Queen Mary University of London in 2023/24 and 2024/25. The author, however, is a physicist, and it shows: wherever possible, ideas are explained with physical intuition rather than heavy formalism. Readers with a background in physics or mathematics who want a self-contained, introductory route into modern machine learning may therefore find these notes particularly friendly. The notes start from maximum likelihood, least squares, linear regression and (stochastic) gradient descent. They then cover neural networks, backpropagation, the vanishing gradient problem, batch and layer normalization, overfitting and regularization, adversarial examples, and the kernel method. The second half turns to natural language processing: word embeddings, recurrent networks and LSTMs, the attention mechanism and Transformers, and large language models, including scaling laws, the history of GPT, instruction tuning, reinforcement learning from human feedback, hallucination, alignment faking, chain-of-thought reasoning and test-time scaling. The emphasis on large language models reflects requests from the students. The notes are aimed at third- and fourth-year students in the UK system. Because the course was also taken by students from other departments, very little is assumed: even basic material such as matrix multiplication is explained from scratch, so readers familiar with it can safely skip such parts. No originality is claimed; the aim is a coherent, intuitive path through the material. Developments after spring 2025 are not covered, but the basic ideas emphasized here are unlikely to go out of date soon.
summary_zh: 物理与数学背景读者缺乏现代机器学习的直观入门路径，作者基于授课笔记提供自洽导引。
课程从线性回归与梯度下降出发，覆盖神经网络、反向传播、正则化及核方法等核心基础。
后半部分聚焦NLP与LLM，涵盖Transformer、RLHF、幻觉及思维链推理，强调物理直觉讲解。
comment: 115 pages, many figures. Based on lectures given at Queen Mary University of London

title: Even Loose Proximity Constraints Make Makespan-optimal Unlabeled Multi-agent Pathfinding Hard
title_zh: 松弛邻近约束使最优无标签多智能体寻路变难
abstract: We study \textsc{$r$-Connected Unlabeled Multi-agent Pathfinding} ($r$CUMAPF), a variant of MAPF where interchangeable agents have a proximity range $r\in \mathbb{N}$, and agents must form a single group in a given graph $G$ through limited-range communication at all times. The problem arises in fundamental applications such as self-reconfiguration and platooning, while standard MAPF does not capture proximity constraints. For the problem of finding a makespan-optimal solution, prior work shows \NP-hardness for $r=1$ and polynomial-time solvability when $r$ is sufficiently large; the complexity for the intermediate case $2\le r$ is largely unknown. To narrow this gap, we show that finding a solution to $r$CUMAPF with makespan at most $2$ is \NP-hard for $2\le r= O(|V|^{1-\varepsilon})$, where $0<\varepsilon\le 1$ is a fixed constant and $|V|$ is the number of vertices. As a consequence, we show that the labeled analogue of $r$CUMAPF is also \NP-hard under the same condition.
summary_zh: 标准MAPF未考虑邻近约束，而自重构和编队等应用需智能体保持通信连通，故研究rCUMAPF问题。
针对寻找时间最优解的复杂度中间态未知问题，证明当2≤r=O(|V|^{1-ε})时，寻找makespan至多为2的解是NP-hard的。
结论填补了r=1与r充分大之间的复杂度空白，并推得相同条件下的有标签同类问题也是NP-hard的。

title: CAE-Bench: Benchmarking AI Agents for Reusable CAE Solver Development
title_zh: CAE-Bench：评估可复用CAE求解器开发AI智能体的基准
abstract: We developed CAE-Bench, a benchmark to evaluate AI agents on Computer-Aided Engineering (CAE) solver development. A CAE solver is more than a PDE solver; it must be able to generalize across various inputs, such as different boundary conditions, geometries, and material properties. CAE-Bench evaluates the generalizability of AI-developed CAE solvers by providing the same task, such as a heat transfer problem, multiple cases, with each case specifying an input. The AI agent develops a solver for a fixed task using only a few public cases, and the resulting solver is then tested on held-out cases, i.e., cases it has never seen before. We evaluate 12 models across a range of reasoning settings on 80 computational tasks. Our experiments show that even if a solver developed by an AI agent performs well on the public cases, it may even get 0 score on held-out cases. For tasks such as fluid dynamics problems, even the solver developed by GPT-6 Astra performs poorly on held-out cases. A data format and an SDK for task registration are provided, so the researcher can use the benchmark on their own infrastructure. We hope that CAE-Bench will help the community to develop AI agents that can develop reusable CAE solvers that generalize to various inputs.
summary_zh: 现有AI智能体开发的CAE求解器泛化能力不足，难以适应多变的边界条件与几何等输入。
提出CAE-Bench基准，让AI智能体用少量公开案例开发求解器，并在未见案例上测试其泛化性。
实验表明AI开发的求解器易在未见案例上得零分，流体力学任务表现尤差；同时提供了数据格式与SDK。
问题：AI开发的CAE求解器泛化能力未知；方法：构建CAE-Bench基准测试未见案例表现；结论：现有模型泛化极差，亟需提升。
comment: 18 pages, 6 figures, 8 tables. Zhiyu Zhou and Tianyou Liu contributed equally

title: Evaluating Authorization and Trust Boundaries in Agentic Orchestration Frameworks
title_zh: 智能体编排框架的授权与信任边界评估
abstract: Agentic AI systems extend large language models with tools, memory, and multi-agent collaboration, introducing security risks at orchestration boundaries. These risks depend on how identities are represented, operations are authorized, and instructions or information propagate between components. We evaluate LangChain, LangGraph, AutoGen, and OpenClaw through twelve experiments mapped to the OWASP Top 10 for Agentic Applications using a common LLM (gpt-4o-mini). The experiments cover prompt injection, unauthorized resource access and command execution, memory poisoning, and inter-agent trust and identity attacks. Adversarial inputs induced unauthorized tool invocation, while tool chaining, stale filesystem validation, encoded instructions, and inter-agent delegation exposed weaknesses in authorization across component boundaries. Memory poisoning showed that untrusted state can influence responses, a risk distinct from conventional access-control violations. In the evaluated protected configurations, explicit authorization, controlled capability assignment, filesystem containment, and execution safeguards prevented specific unauthorized operations. The findings emphasize preserving authorization and information-trust boundaries throughout agentic workflows rather than treating framework capabilities or model-level instructions as sufficient security guarantees.
summary_zh: 智能体系统在编排边界存在安全风险，需评估身份表示、操作授权及信息传播机制。
基于OWASP Top 10对四个框架进行实验，发现提示注入、内存污染及跨组件授权等弱点。
显式授权与执行防护可阻止未授权操作，强调须全程保持授权与信任边界而非依赖模型指令。

title: Stream of Belief: Eliciting Collective Intelligence through Latent Belief Dynamics
title_zh: 信念流：通过潜在信念动态激发集体智能
abstract: In this work, we view multi-agent reasoning as a process of seeking a collective equilibrium of implicit belief dynamics and introduce Stream of Belief (SoB), where agents maintain continuous latent beliefs and iteratively refine them through communication and reflection. Our method seeks a collective belief state of a multi-agent system where further communication induces no meaningful information propagation. Through extensive experiments, we demonstrate the generalization of SoB across tasks and model families. More Broadly, our results suggest a new perspective on scaling multi-agent reasoning from belief dynamics.
summary_zh: 多智能体推理缺乏对隐式信念动态的集体均衡考量，导致信息交互低效。
提出SoB方法，让智能体维持连续潜在信念，通过通信与反思迭代优化直至信息不再有效传播。
实验证明SoB跨任务与模型泛化性强，为扩展多智能体推理提供了基于信念动态的新视角。

title: Specifying & Verifying Quantum Error-Correcting Codes
title_zh: 量子纠错码的形式化规约与验证
abstract: Building quantum computers is challenging due to the noise that affects qubits. Quantum error correction tackles noise by encoding information in quantum error-correcting (QEC) codes. These codes are often complex, increasingly found by computational search, presented in diverse formalisms with informal arguments, and hard to reason about algorithmically. Given that the rest of the quantum computing stack relies on a QEC code's properties for correct computation, we propose a formally verified foundation for QEC codes. We present QECLean, a Lean-based framework for formally specifying and verifying QEC codes. QECLean backs every claimed QEC-code property with a machine-checked proof, unifies the diverse presentations of codes in the literature through common abstractions, and makes new codes easy to specify. We present a new compositional technique, code combinators, for proving code distance analytically. Code combinators allow us to prove the distance of large codes that are out of reach for algorithmic techniques; for example, we show that IBM's $[[360, 12, \leq 24]]$ code has distance 24, which was previously only known as an upper bound. Furthermore, we show how our approach allows us to formalize and prove entire code families, such as the surface code. Our work lays the foundation required for reasoning about circuit-level implementations of codes on given architectures and for building end-to-end verified compilers for quantum computers. QECLean is available at https://github.com/Stavan-Jain/QECLean
summary_zh: 量子纠错码日益复杂且形式多样，缺乏严格证明，难以算法推理，威胁量子计算栈正确性。
提出基于Lean的QECLean框架，对纠错码属性提供机器检验证明，统一文献中的多种表示。
引入码组合子解析证明码距，确定IBM大码的精确码距为24，并形式化证明表面码族，为端到端验证编译器奠基。

title: InclusionMed: Benchmarking AI for Inclusive Healthcare
title_zh: InclusionMed：面向包容性医疗的AI基准测试
abstract: Advancing medical AI for inclusive healthcare requires evaluation across diverse healthcare roles, tasks, and care settings, but benchmark coverage remains uneven. We introduce InclusionMed, an open medical AI evaluation initiative for inclusive healthcare. The InclusionMed Atlas organizes benchmarks across three healthcare roles and three AI capabilities. For the first release, we selected four public benchmarks from 388 candidates through structured audits and independent reproduction. With InclusionMed-DxFiles, our private diagnostic reasoning benchmark, the Atlas contains five benchmarks covering three of its nine role--capability cells. We evaluated frontier large language models on the Atlas and aggregated their results into the InclusionMed Index, with overall scores ranging from 17.5 to 49.1 out of 100. The Index also reports scores by healthcare role and AI capability, showing that a model's rank varied with the role or capability considered. A within-benchmark analysis using task-level tags showed that the ten highest-ranked models in the Index all scored higher on patient communication than on clinical decision-making. Models with similar Index scores also differed substantially in estimated inference cost. These findings highlight the need for evaluation covering more diverse healthcare needs and for context-specific model selection. Through open collaboration and community contributions, InclusionMed seeks to ensure that diverse healthcare needs worldwide shape how medical AI progress is defined and measured.
summary_zh: 现有医疗AI基准测试覆盖不均，缺乏对多元医疗角色与任务的评估，故提出InclusionMed开放评估倡议。
构建InclusionMed Atlas，从388个候选中选出4个公开基准并引入私有诊断基准，评估前沿LLM并汇总为InclusionMed Index。
评估发现模型排名随角色与能力变化，且患者沟通得分普遍高于临床决策，同分模型推理成本差异大，凸显了多元评估与按需选型的必要性。
comment: 31 pages, 8 figures, 10 tables. Project website: https://inclusionmed.ai/

title: Validating LLM-Based Essay Scorers: A Comparative Analysis in Critical Online Reasoning in Medical Education
title_zh: 验证基于LLM的作文评分器：医学教育中的比较分析
abstract: Automated essay scorers (AES) based on large language models (LLMs) promise human-level accuracy. However, training, fine-tuning, and evaluating LLMs for specific assessment tasks is costly. In particular, the question arises whether these AES should be trained for specific domains or whether models based on generic LLMs might be sufficient. Human annotations, by contrast, are often more valid but far more expensive. This study evaluates whether ensembles of AES systems based on general-purpose LLMs can approximate human ratings of medical-education writing tasks by leveraging encoded linguistic and conceptual knowledge. The goal is to assess whether general-purpose models are applicable for assisting or potentially replacing human annotation in this domain. We experiment with 11 AES systems and 8 different LLMs and evaluate 668 student responses to 12 tasks, using \numprint{2076} evaluations by 7 human annotators. These ratings are aggregated to create consistent performance levels that can be used as target classes for classifiers trained on AES outputs. Our results show that learner classes based on human ratings can be accurately reconstructed using a linear SVM trained on a small set of AES features. A single classifier generalized well across tasks and domains, with reasoning and content features being most predictive. This suggests that out-of-the-box LLMs, even without domain-specific fine-tuning, can support automatic essay grading in medical education. While individual AES systems are insufficient alone, their combination approximates human evaluators, pointing to a reduced need for manual scoring or its supplementation with automated methods.
summary_zh: 针对LLM作文评分器是否需领域微调的问题，研究评估通用LLM集成能否近似人类评分。
结合11个评分系统与8个LLM处理医学教育写作任务，用线性SVM对聚合的人类评分进行分类重建。
结果表明，无需领域微调的通用LLM集成即可有效辅助自动评分，减少人工评分需求。

title: A Polynomial Time Algorithm for Finding a Minimum 5-Partition of a Submodular Function
title_zh: 求次模函数最小5-划分的多项式时间算法
abstract: Given a real-valued submodular function on a finite ground set, the minimum $k$-partition problem asks for a partition into $k$ nonempty parts minimizing the sum of their function values. We give a polynomial-time algorithm for $k=5$. The idea follows directly from the previous $k=4$ result, where there is precisely one obstruction for generalizing it to $k=5$. We show the special case can be handled by reasoning about a restricted family of $3$-partitions.
summary_zh: 针对次模函数最小k-划分问题，本文研究其k=5时的求解方法，给出了多项式时间算法。
k=4推广至k=5时存在唯一障碍，本文方法直接基于此前k=4的结果以克服该障碍。
通过分析受限的3-划分族，成功处理了该特例情况，证明了k=5时存在多项式时间解法。

title: TRACK: Tool-Augmented Reasoning over Time Series for Fault Diagnosis in Power Management System
title_zh: TRACK：面向电源管理故障诊断的时序工具增强推理
abstract: Fault diagnosis in power management systems running multiple loads relies on experts manually inspecting current and voltage waveforms, which fails to scale across deployed units. We present TRACK, which pairs a time series encoder with a Small Language Model to produce structured, physics-grounded diagnostic reports, calling tools for exact, verifiable calculations. It operates on-device, keeping proprietary sensor data local and avoiding expensive API calls. We introduce a rubric-based framework that evaluates these reports by scoring structure, signal fidelity, physics reasoning, diagnosis, and actionability through per-criterion verdicts. On a 15-class multi-load simulated benchmark, TRACK achieves over 95% fault-category accuracy and generalizes to out-of-distribution faults, whereas the best encoder-probing baseline reaches only 58% accuracy.
summary_zh: 电源管理故障诊断依赖人工检查波形，难以大规模扩展。
提出TRACK框架，结合时序编码器与小型语言模型，调用工具进行精确计算，生成物理可解释的诊断报告。
在15类基准测试中，TRACK准确率超95%且能泛化至分布外故障，远超基线模型的58%。

title: Scientific Coding with Large Language Models: Evidence from Finite Element Analysis
abstract: Large language models (LLMs) offer a potential route to automating scientific programming, but their usefulness depends on consistently producing numerically correct code. We extend FEM-Bench to 17 finite element tasks involving nonlinear and history-dependent mechanics and structural dynamics, and evaluate 15 models on implementation and test generation without execution feedback. The best model succeeds in 87.1% of single-pass implementation trials, but rankings differ between tracks. The leading implementer achieves 49.9% joint test success, while the leading tester reaches 82.6%. For six models, we compare single-pass generation with two agentic harnesses that allow code execution and revision. Agentic execution solves some tasks that never succeeded in single-pass trials and improves consistency on others, but gains vary across models and harnesses, and regressions also occur. Claude Opus 5 with SimpleAgent reaches 96.5% Pass@3, the probability of at least one success in three attempts, but 77.1% Pass$^3$, the probability that all three succeed. No model-harness combination exceeds 78.8% Pass$^3$. To understand why agents submit incorrect code after passing their own checks, we analyze 249 failed agentic trajectories and identify six categories of self-verification failure. The most common are inadequate test coverage (73.1%) and reliance on generic consistency checks (70.3%), and in 28.5% of cases the tests share an error with the implementation. Motivated by these findings, an exploratory configuration with separate coder and tester agents achieves the highest observed scores, with 97.6% Pass@3 and 88.8% Pass$^3$. These results identify consistency across attempts and independent verification as the main obstacles to trusting LLM-generated scientific code.

title: Microstate Response Model: A Unified IRT Framework from Latent Nominal States to a Theory of Tests
title_zh: 微观状态响应模型：从潜名义状态到测验理论的统一IRT框架
abstract: Several features outside of the conventional assumptions in traditional item response theory (IRT) models have been revealed to be related, yet no unifying framework explains the features simultaneously. They can be unified by treating each cause as a distinct reason, and then regarding every reason as a choice in a latent multiple-choice item. Here, we propose the Microstate Response Model (MiRM), which decomposes each response category (macrostate) into multiple latent reasons (microstates) using Boltzmann weights. The consequences of this simple framework are substantial; for example, it reads the lower and upper asymptotes of item characteristic curves (ICCs) as additional states, and ICC asymmetry and item complexity as multiple states. The model unifies many classical models from the dichotomous logistic family to mixture models. Moreover, the algebra of the model provides the intuition that items and tests are the same object. Two consequences naturally come out: partial credits and test scores are unified, and a new test-level monotonicity condition is proposed. We examine item characteristics including nonmonotonicity on PISA 2015, and show that MiRM provides a deeper understanding of items while achieving the strongest overall performance across fit, parsimony, and prediction.
summary_zh: 传统IRT模型外的多个特征缺乏统一解释框架，本文提出微观状态响应模型MiRM，将宏观响应分解为多个潜原因的微观状态。
MiRM利用Boltzmann权重分解响应类别，将ICC的上下渐近线、非对称性及项目复杂度解释为附加或多重状态，从而统一了多种经典模型。
该模型的代数性质揭示项目与测验为同一对象，统一了部分信用与测验分数，并提出新测验级单调性条件，在PISA数据上展现出最优综合性能。

title: Edit Recommendation: Can LLMs Anticipate Edit Requests from Users, and When?
title_zh: LLM能否及何时预测用户的编辑请求
abstract: After a large language model (LLM) agent generates an artifact, users often send edit requests for it. This paper studies whether an LLM can anticipate these requests before they are sent. Such anticipation is useful in practice because it reduces the effort of user review and feedback. We formalize this task as edit recommendation and build EditRecBench, a benchmark for evaluating the performance of LLMs on this task, from real-world conversation logs in WildChat-4.8M. Through benchmarking and failure analysis, we identify a practical challenge that some cases are inherently difficult to predict in real-world settings. To address this, we introduce decision model-based gating to filter out cases where predictions are unlikely to be correct before they are presented to the user. Our trained model outperforms existing decision models and raises pass@5 among shown suggestions by 12--25 points at a gating threshold. Our code is available at https://github.com/ntt-dkiku/llm-edit-recommendation.
summary_zh: LLM生成内容后常需用户修改，为减少用户反馈成本，提出编辑推荐任务以预测用户编辑请求。
基于WildChat构建EditRecBench基准，发现部分真实场景的编辑请求难以预测。
引入决策模型门控过滤不可预测案例，训练后的模型使展示建议的pass@5提升12-25点。

title: From Repositories to Training Environments: Scaling Long-Horizon Coding Agents with Environment Evolution Loop
title_zh: 基于环境演化循环扩展长周期编程Agent
abstract: Training coding agents for long-horizon tasks requires environments with verifiable feedback. Existing pipelines often follow a linear process that ends with validation, establishing usability but providing little guidance on improving training value. Recursive self-improvement (RSI) often requires model rollouts or model training followed by downstream evaluation, with costs and feedback delays amplified on long-horizon tasks. How can we use timely, reliable proxy signals to improve training value and synthesize environments at scale? We present RepoFactory, an automated pipeline that converts real repositories into verifiable environments where agents build complete projects from scratch given a language specification. Its Environment Evolution Loop optimizes a multiplicative objective combining validity, structural coupling, and implementation scope through proxy feedback. RepoFactory produces 10,159 environments across 17 software domains. Training Qwen3.5-35B-A3B on these environments yields RepoHorizen-35B-A3B, which achieves gains of 22.6 percentage points on NL2Repo-Bench and 8.5 points on average across five benchmarks covering long-horizon coding and agentic tasks in real-world production settings, compared with 17.5 and 6.4 points without environment evolution. These results highlight the training value of RepoFactory environments and the additional gains from the Environment Evolution Loop.
summary_zh: 长周期编程任务缺乏高质量可验证训练环境，现有线性流程难以提升环境训练价值且反馈延迟高。
提出RepoFactory自动流水线，通过环境演化循环优化有效性、结构耦合与实现范围的乘积目标，规模化合成环境。
基于此训练的模型在NL2Repo-Bench提升22.6分，五项基准平均提升8.5分，验证了环境演化循环的增益。

title: Linglong Agent Service: A Runtime for Centralized Agent Reasoning and Distributed Execution
title_zh: Linglong Agent 服务：集中推理与分布式执行运行时
abstract: LLM agents can use remote tools and cloud sandboxes, but integrating reasoning, session state, and heterogeneous execution sites remains a runtime design problem. We present Linglong Agent Service (agentsvc), a self-hosted HTTP service and embeddable Python runtime that treats execution site as a configurable dimension alongside model, tools, and context. A parent service retains inference orchestration, tool descriptions, and conversation history; each inference request selects one child environment for file, shell, terminal, and MCP operations. Direct HTTP and child-initiated WebSocket tunnels carry the same application interfaces, including portable request context and centrally managed updates. The normal core path requires no third-party Python packages, with an optional Windows pseudo-terminal dependency. We further present online_debugger as the process-scale special case of execution-site separation: an instrumented program submits exception evidence, executes session-scoped inspection tools inside the incident process, and resumes the same diagnostic session. Its default prompt requires failing-then-passing reproduction evidence for source changes, while runtime patch activation and failed-call recovery remain unimplemented. We explain the design through constrained expected-utility reasoning, compare concrete mechanisms with Hermes Agent, Pi, Codex, and Claude Code, and report implementation and regression-test evidence. The current evidence establishes executable contracts, not performance advantages, repair accuracy, or production recovery. The source code is open source under the MIT license at https://github.com/mz24cn/agents.
summary_zh: LLM agent 难以统一推理、会话状态与异构执行站点，本文提出 Linglong Agent Service 解决该运行时设计问题。
该运行时将执行站点视为可配置维度，父服务保留推理编排与历史，子环境执行具体操作，通过 HTTP 与 WebSocket 通信。
提出 online_debugger 实现进程级执行分离，当前证据验证了可执行契约，尚未实现运行时补丁激活与故障恢复。

title: CivilBench: Benchmarking Vision-Language Models for Multimodal Information Integration in Civil Engineering
title_zh: CivilBench：土木工程多模态信息整合的VLM基准
abstract: Artificial intelligence (AI), particularly large language models (LLMs) and vision-language models (VLMs), is increasingly applied in civil and structural engineering for disaster assessment, structural analysis, and engineering decision support.
